title: Trait
description: A named committee-member trait. SPEC-COMM-5: each trait declares always-on effects (preferred_rate_shift, band_modifier) and optional signal-reactive hooks that are dormant until the referenced world-state series exists.

id.description: Stable unique trait id, e.g. trait.hawkish_lean.

name.description: Localization key for the trait name.

desc.description: Localization key for the trait description.

effects.description: Always-on effects applied every meeting regardless of world-state signal.

preferred_rate_shift.description: Additive shift to the member's preferred rate in rate units. Positive = hawkish lean.

band_modifier.description: Fractional adjustment to compromise_band. -0.3 narrows the band by 30%; 0 = no effect.

signal_hooks.description: Signal-reactive effects declared but dormant until the referenced world-state series exists (awaiting sectoral price modeling).

signal.description: World-state series id this hook reacts to (e.g. sector.ag_prices). Dormant while absent from state.vars.

direction.description: 1 = hawkish reaction (rates rise with signal deviation), -1 = dovish.

magnitude.description: Rate shift per unit of signal deviation above its reference level.
